task: Find a walkthrough for the game "The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild" on ign.
final_result_response:
Found the walkthrough for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild on IGN:

URL: https://www.ign.com/wikis/the-legend-of-zelda-breath-of-the-wild/Walkthrough

Title: Walkthrough - The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild Guide - IGN

It includes detailed strategies for the main story from Link's awakening to final boss, with recommended order:
- The Shrine of Resurrection (Great Plateau)
- Follow the Sheikah Slate, The Isolated Plateau, Seek Out Impa, Locked Mementos, Find the Fairy Fountain, Captured Memories, Free the Divine Beasts (Reach Zora's Domain / Vah Ruta, Vah Rudania, Vah Medoh, Forbidden City Entry / Vah Naboris), The Hero's Sword, Destroy Ganon
Plus Master Trials DLC (Trial of the Sword), Champions' Ballad DLC, and 76 Side Quests, Shrines, Korok Seeds, Armor, Cooking, etc. By Brendan Graeber and others, updated Jun 25, 2025.
